root_cause: The authenticated Brain runtime adapter converted source PROVEN to only healthy=true/status=ok and discarded tenant, regression and production proof. The UI then displayed Bewezen in Brain based only on these two health flags.
failedApproach: Merged #4673 tests treated healthy:true/status:ok without a regression or provider proof as one proven record; Required+CodeQL could pass the wrong fixture.
fix: Preserve actual canonical maturity and verified producer readback from /api/brain-operating-loop; gate learning counts and labels on same-tenant immutable proof; treat missing source details as unverified.
prevention_rule: Every customer-facing PROVEN label must be backed by same-tenant canonical maturity PROVEN, concrete fix, executable regression and a real allowed HTTPS provider/production readback; healthy/status alone must never turn unknown into verified.
